notes: Replication DOCX is BA_OSF.docx from the named OSF project; its reference list identifies Förster (2022), The Chameleon Effect: A Replication Study. Printed metric retained. Primary planned main analysis selected, not exploratory or outlier sensitivity analyses. Original primary scanned PDF title and authors verified; statistic quotes visually checked against PDF page 7 to correct OCR punctuation. Original simple effects for face rubbing and foot shaking are distinct from the omnibus interaction F(1, 34) = 9.36, p = .004. Replication tests are the corresponding outcome-specific interactions across session and confederate order. DOCX pagination was not reconstructed; section and paragraph provide exact text locations.
